concerns.text: T000c-stats-def depends on T000c-impl, but T000c-impl (Generate research.md) is listed as a parallel [P] task with 'Dependency: None'. T000c-stats-def cannot run in parallel if it requires the output of T000c-impl. This violates the [P] tag and the producer-consumer flow.

T000d-impl (Generate data-model.md) depends on T000c-impl, but is marked [P]. T000a-def depends on T000d-impl, but is also marked [P]. These tasks form a strict serial chain (T000c -> T000d -> T000a) but are all tagged as parallel-safe, which is a semantic violation of the [P] constraint.

T008c depends on T008a-exec and T007b. T008a-exec depends on T008a-impl. T008a-impl depends on T008a-static-data. This is a valid chain, but T008a-static-data is marked [P] with 'Dependency: None'. However, T008a-impl requires the file generated by T008a-static-data. If T008a-static-data is not completed first, T008a-impl fails. The [P] tag on T008a-static-data is acceptable, but the chain must be strictly enforced in execution order, which the current 'Parallel Opportunities' section implies might be loose.

T014c-impl depends on T011, T012, T019d-impl, T011a-curate. T011 depends on T044a-impl and T054a-impl. T044a-impl and T054a-impl are marked [P] but depend on T000d-impl. T011 is marked [P] but depends on T044a-impl and T054a-impl. This creates a deep dependency chain where multiple tasks are incorrectly marked as [P] (parallel-safe) when they are actually sequential dependencies of T011.

T014c-parse-check depends on T014c-impl and T011a-curate. T014c-exclude depends on T014c-impl, T014c-parse-check, and T019d-impl. T014c-exec depends on T014c-impl. The ordering here is mostly correct (impl -> parse -> exclude -> exec), but T014c-parse-check and T014c-exclude are marked [P] despite having explicit dependencies on T014c-impl and each other. They cannot run in parallel with their dependencies.

T036 depends on T014e-exec, T044b-verify, T054b-verify. T014e-exec depends on T014e-impl. T014e-impl depends on T014c-exec. T044b-verify depends on T044a-impl. T054b-verify depends on T054a-impl. T044a-impl and T054a-impl depend on T000d-impl. T011 depends on T044a-impl and T054a-impl. T014c-impl depends on T011. This creates a complex web where T036 depends on tasks that are far upstream. The [P] tags on T044b-verify and T054b-verify are incorrect as they depend on T044a-impl and T054a-impl respectively.

T025 depends on T021, T023, T019d-impl. T026 depends on T025, T011a-curate. T027 depends on T025, T021. T028 depends on T012, T025. T029 depends on T025. All these tasks are marked [P], but they form a strict dependency chain where T025 must complete before T026, T027, T028, and T029 can start. The [P] tag is invalid for T026-T029.

T029a-impl depends on T024c. T029b-impl depends on T008c, T024c. T029c-gen depends on T029a-impl, T029b-impl. T029d-derive depends on T024c. T029g depends on T029d-derive. T029a-impl, T029b-impl, T029d-derive are marked [P] but depend on T024c. T029c-gen depends on T029a-impl and T029b-impl, so it cannot be parallel with them. The [P] tags are incorrect for the dependent tasks.
